extraction.Name: Hattie E. Whiting (now Whitcher)
extraction.Recorded patent: Recorded July 3, 1918 by the First National Bank of Spencer, Nebraska
extraction.Buyer: Northeast quarter of the northeast quarter of section 12 conveyed to William D. Bradstreet for $4,000; remainder conveyed to Kate Shaw on February 26, 1924 for a consideration of $1.00
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612834 issued; southeast quarter of the southeast quarter of section 1 and the northeast quarter of the northeast quarter of section 12, township 33, range 12; receipt for patent signed by allottee in February 1918; Mrs. Whiting and her husband mortgaged the land on at least four different occasions
